payload.text: **LESSONS candidates from 0084's review and 0082's build (2026-09-17 evening), vc's call at a fold.** (ww) A control fixture that omits the population's real shape passes vacuously: vc's first census scanner anchored on `^` with no leading space, its control fixture had no indented line, the control said PASS, and the scan missed every indented command-position expansion, `$run "$@"` included. (xx) BSD awk has no `\<`, so a matcher using it matches nothing on macOS and everything looks clean -- the second census missed `exec $run` for that reason alone. (yy) A prefix assignment to BASHOPTS or SHELLOPTS is refused in bash and accepted in zsh, so a measurement taken in this tool's zsh did not reproduce inside bats until it went through `env`; measure in the shell the code will run in. (zz) A format string used as DATA must go through `printf '%s\n'`: a test stub wrote `printf "printf [%s] *.md\n"` and the %s was eaten, so the arm compared against a string that never existed. (aaa) `return` inside a subshell in a function ends the subshell and the function carries on, measured; `exit` says the same thing and reads as what it does. (bbb) An inherited BASHOPTS or SHELLOPTS changes globbing in every bash devbin starts, while GLOBIGNORE and GLOBSORT arrive INERT -- and `local GLOBIGNORE` would activate the inherited value as the local left scope, so pinning it would be the bug.
